# Be ready with solutions for busy Entertainment accounts


## Entertainment Risks Heat Up When the Weather Cools Down


#### From fall festivals to New Year’s Eve events, Q4 brings peak traffic and peak exposure for many Entertainment accounts.


#### **Make Kinsale your first call for solutions.**


---


#### **Broad Appetite • GL, Liquor, & Cannabis • $1,500 MP**


---


Fall and winter special events like pumpkin patches, NYE celebrations, and seasonal ice rinks increase revenue and risk for many entertainment accounts. Even year-round activities like escape rooms and axe throwing see peak traffic as cold weather sends more people indoors. **This is not the time to be short on coverage.**


Kinsale’s[Entertainment Division](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/specialty-casualty/entertainment/) delivers:


- General Liability with flexible claimant limits from $100,000 to $1M
- Higher occurrence & aggregate limit options when traditional excess is not a fit
- Liquor & Impairment Liability for venues serving alcohol or cannabis
- Customized special events coverage with no attendance limits
